# 딜브릿지 DealBridge (dealbridge.asia)

> DealBridge is the trade & sourcing arm of BRIDGE GROUP (브릿지그룹), a Korea–China trading group founded in September 2025 in Gwangju, South Korea. Group companies: DealBridge (sourcing, investment, M&A), ABridge Co., Ltd. (strategic materials, semiconductor equipment, food security — www.abridge.co.kr), Ecobridge (petrochemicals, PBAT/PLA biodegradable materials — www.ecobridge.biz), CHINANEWS (bilingual China markets terminal and supply desk — chinanews.kr). Founder & Chairman: Seong Ouk Jung (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/seong-ouk-jung-33996a2ba).

Site language: Korean. English specifications, live China spot prices and RFQ forms for every supply line are on https://chinanews.kr/supply/ (Korean: https://chinanews.kr/ko/supply/).

## Core supply lines (producer-direct from licensed Chinese producers)
- Rare earths — oxides, metals and magnet alloys for Nd, Pr, Dy, Tb, Y and the full lanthanide range (3N–5N, COA, samples, export licence handled): https://chinanews.kr/supply/rare-earths.html
- Chinese semiconductors — MCU, power devices (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN), memory, analog, sensors, LEDs from authorised channels; no EOL or open-market stock: https://chinanews.kr/supply/semiconductors.html
- High-purity copper 5N/6N — ingot, rod, granule with full-element GDMS certificates: https://chinanews.kr/supply/high-purity-copper.html
- Also: yttrium, gallium, terbium, tungsten, germanium, hafnium, semiconductor materials (SiC, HF, Y2O3): https://chinanews.kr/supply/
- Other lines: PBAT/PLA biodegradable materials, HDPE/LLDPE/LDPE, aT state-trading grains (rice 30,000 t, corn 300,000 t quotas)

## Milestones
- June 2026: first Korean direct export of SiC focus-ring CVD furnace systems (4 lines) to a Chinese semiconductor equipment maker — https://chinanews.kr/press/abridge-sic-cvd-20260615.html
- 2026: 25% equity stake and board seat in a mineral-water and beverage joint venture in Mudanjiang, Heilongjiang, China
- aT (Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corp.) state-trading participant

## Compliance
Every enquiry is classified under Korea's strategic-items rules (YESTRADE) and screened against U.S., UN and EU sanctions lists before quotation. Samples and producer certificates on every lot.
